You'll be installed at a table of 6 to 8 people, you speak the language indicated for 15min, then you change language.

about.title: About Gengoffee
about.subtitle: Who are we?
about.description:
One step to learn a language is to practice. With Gengoffee, we wanted to create a place where people would be able to complete their learning through reel interactions and exchanges.

We are are a French-Japanese association that offers language exchange events where participants are able to meet other people from around the world exceptionally from France, Japan or English spoken countries.
about.followus: Follow us on our social media.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.description:
Our language exchange association in Paris and Tokyo aims to create authentic moments of practice and exchange between French, English and Japanese speakers. Through our events, we promote natural communication and cultural openness in a structured, welcoming and convivial environment.

Unlike a free tandem or a simple meetup, exchanges at Gengoffee are supervised by a team present on site, which ensures a linguistic balance and a fluid dynamic between participants, whatever their level of language proficiency.

At Gengoffee, we believe that learning a language is above all about human experience: meeting, exchanging, discovering other ways of thinking and communicating.

1.description: Every Gengoffee event takes place in a warm and relaxed setting. The friendly vibe helps participants open up, laugh, and connect naturally over a shared drink.

2.description: Our team is present at every session to ensure smooth exchanges and a balanced dynamic between participants, whatever their level of language proficiency.

3.title: Little shared pleasures
3.description: A good drink, great company, and a meaningful conversation. At Gengoffee, small everyday moments of joy are at the heart of every memorable exchange.

4.description: We welcome participants from all walks of life, backgrounds, and nationalities. Diversity is at the core of every exchange and makes each event truly unique.

paris.title: Paris, France
paris.description: Born in the heart of Paris, Gengoffee brings together French, Japanese and English speakers every week. From lively bars to cosy venues, each event is a unique chance to connect, practise languages and live an authentic moment of cultural exchange in the French capital.

tokyo.title: Tokyo, Japan
tokyo.description: In the vibrant city of Tokyo, Gengoffee creates a welcoming space for language enthusiasts. Whether you are a local or an expat, our events offer a unique opportunity to meet new people, practise your French and discover Tokyo through an open and multicultural lens.

why.title: Why choose Gengoffee?
why.description:
Gengoffee is a French-Japanese association in Paris gathering French and Japanese people during events.

We have the concept of organising French-Japanese language exchanges in an altruistic, friendly and cultural spirit. In this spirit, we organise our events in cafes and bars in order to chat around a drink!

We organise several events per month and accept all levels as long as respect is present.
